biasDisclosure.survivorshipBias: REAL AND UNCORRECTED. Backfill covers only the CURRENT listed universe (108 symbols). Symbols delisted, merged, or dropped from the universe between 2014 and 2026 are absent. Backtests over this data will overstate win rates because losers that left the market are invisible.

biasDisclosure.implication: Harness verdicts (regime_pattern_execution) on this data are directional evidence, not survivorship-free proof. The survivorship-free reference remains the live paper/settle loop (lens_live_journal_kr.csv) and index-level analysis.
